name: Arkar
description: The Arkar Connector lets users of the Arkar platform query their investment fund data in natural language inside Claude — read-only. It surfaces fund registry (tax ID, type, status), structure (classes, subclasses, series), named service providers, and regulatory obligations, scoped strictly to the funds each user already has access to on the platform. Arkar is a fund-administration platform for the Brazilian regulated market (CVM/ANBIMA).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Arkar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Arkar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://arkar-system-mcp.fly.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Arkar MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Arkar provides these MCP tools: detalhe_fundo, estrutura_fundo, listar_fundos_acessiveis, obrigacoes_regulatorias, and prestadores_do_fundo.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Arkar?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Arkar in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Arkar requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Arkar is developed by Arkar Tecnologia Ltda. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
